findings.resolution: P10-U01 is labeled CLOSED_USER_ADOPTED with an explicit RG-SCI residual, not CLOSED_SCIENTIFIC. The pre-existing user authorization and reconciliation note limit ingestion to P10-U01; later-stage decisions in the source remain unconsumed and their science gates remain open.

The checkpoint suite passes 2-rank continuous/write/restart and a 2-rank checkpoint restarted at 1 rank. All four redistribution guard cases pass at 1-to-1, 2-to-2, and 2-to-1 ranks, including corrupt identity and nonperiodic-coordinate rejection before particle deserialization.

negativeAboveIntegratedTolerance now receives the caller's actual S_L1. Pairwise checks use abs(before)+abs(after), global inventory checks use the L1 scale of all accounted live and cumulative inventory, and the unit test proves the 1e-10*S_L1 branch is reachable at system scale.

The ownership check unions uncommitted paths with the committed three-dot diff from immutable pre-C08 commit 2e7bb249fecdd4c0764190b3e0ee3ee26f29f0d3. Final evidence checks 55 paths and reports no unexpected path.

Every enabled AuditP10Ledger boundary now performs an MPI-global L1 assertion that P_D/P_E/P_F working and increment blocks are finite and exactly empty before committed inventory is read. O01, O10, and CHECKPOINT_WRITE execute this path in the passing runtime suites.

The final executable is self-attributed to clean source commit a33e37749450432fb15c1021fc554a26f4e3fc7d and tree 333613990076476707f7e8aa82b1119e2d9a3f58. The build wrapper captures logs outside the source tree until after linking, so the embedded provenance and BUILD.json agree.

The P ledger retains exported_p as the exchange-derived provenance hook. Bootstrap A remains a separate carbon-accounting concern outside C08, and O09 remains unimplemented. No C09-plus behavior was introduced.
Final evidence uses 'clean build' only for the clean attributed source commit and separately identifies evidence generation after linking.
BUILD.json and AMOUNT_UNIT.json are emitted as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark and parse with a strict UTF-8 JSON reader.

O07 follows split so newly created children, ownership, bonds, and MPI placement are final before bonded transport. O08 follows bonded transport so fusion consumes the once-transported state and resolves successor ownership once. Reversing them would require transport over predecessor/stale relationships or an additional rebuild/remap and would change the legacy product sequence. This is technical dependency reasoning, not biological selection.

The adopted v1 contract requires other_exit_d/e/f/events to remain exactly zero. Prohibited loss therefore aborts collectively using the topology reason code before mutation; it must not be converted into a nonzero exit-ledger route.
No push, publication, external sharing, or mentor contact occurred. Existing claim and privacy boundaries remain in force.
